How long does ₹1 lakh take to double? | Kisan Vikas Patra Explained

Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) is a post office savings certificate. At its current 7.5% a year, compounded yearly, money doubles in 115 months: ₹1 lakh becomes ₹2 lakh in 9 years 7 months.
Compare: at the post office savings account's 4%, the same ₹1 lakh takes about 18 years to double (illustrative, compounded yearly).
The rate and maturity period are fixed when you buy the certificate; the minimum is ₹1,000. There is no 80C deduction and the interest is fully taxable, so after tax you keep less than double.
Saving for a child's college or another goal? Check that the maturity date fits it.
